title: RNA-seq Quantification from Published Data
author: Thomas Dugé
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qxhdxj6

steps.title: Download RNA-seq Data
steps.instruction: Identify the RNA-seq runs of interest and download the corresponding fastq files using Prozilla 2.0.4 from the EBI.

substeps.instruction: Assign the DRR/ERR/SRR accession number to the $acc_sra variable in a bash script.
Use Prozilla (proz -k=8 --force -r --no-curses) to download the .fastq.gz files from ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk based on the length of the accession number (9, 10, 11, or other characters).
Decompress the downloaded files using gunzip for both ${acc_sra}_1.fastq.gz and ${acc_sra}_2.fastq.gz.

steps.title: Trim Reads with Trimmomatic
steps.instruction: Trim paired RNA-seq reads using Trimmomatic 0.32.

substeps.instruction: Assign the appropriate file name containing primer sequences to the $adaptfile variable.

Run the Trimmomatic jar command: java -jar /home/tduge/trinity/Trimmomatic-0.32/trimmomatic-0.32.jar PE -threads $thread_number ${acc_sra}_1.fastq ${acc_sra}_2.fastq ${acc_sra}_1P.fq ${acc_sra}_1U.fq ${acc_sra}_2P.fq ${acc_sra}_2U.fq ILLUMINACLIP:$adaptfile:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:36

steps.title: Quantify Transcript Abundance
steps.instruction: Quantify transcript abundance against a reference transcriptome assembly using Salmon 0.8.2.

substeps.instruction: Assign the reference transcriptome fasta assembly to the $sid variable.
Prepare the reference index: salmon index -t $assembly -i ${assembly}_quasi_index --type quasi -k 31
